summary: No silent wrong solid found: 104 rows regenerate byte-for-byte from ep-results.json (only dates/scan text differ), every refusal sentence is plain and appears in the recorded results, and ~45 independent replays and neighbour probes (scale-shifted floors and walls, fold-edge tapers, slanted bores, tapered pockets, slender rods, two fresh fuzz seeds) matched closed forms or were refused. Defects are minor; the shipped-route wrongness and non-wiring are honestly recorded as wrong/unsupported rows.

replays.live: d1h30 -1.7e-4 built; d1h60, d2h100, rrect refused; guard fires

replays.feature: tapered pocket near edge x7 (new probe)

defects.problem: extrude-pocket-measure.mjs rel() divides by max(|ref|,1), so for solids under 1 mm3 (dg-s-0.001 volume 1e-6, dg-s-0.01) the 1e-9 volume bar is effectively absolute and would hide a gross error. Stored ratios contract/analytic are exactly 1.0, so no actual error is hidden.

defects.feature: pocket that leaves a thin wall (row 48/49)
defects.problem: The wall rule is volume-based, so a round hole tangent to or 0.001 mm from a plate edge builds (probe: tangent-hole 6.1e-6, wall-0.001 5.6e-6 off closed form) while rectangular 0.001 mm walls are refused; volume is right but topology (pinched wall) was not inspected and no tangent-hole case is in the evidence.

Bound is relative to total part volume, so a slender rod joined to a large plate builds although the rod itself is badly measured (probe rod d2 h20 + 3000x3000 plate: rod volume 26.7 vs 62.8 true, total only 4e-6 off). Disclosed only as 'curved face from an earlier feature is not checked'; mesh fidelity not measured.
Marked supported while the language reference (brep-rs) still disagrees by up to 1.8% and no third oracle arbitrates; the row itself says the reference text must be corrected before ship.

ep-results vsOcct.ok is false for pd-circle, lf-slant-circle-pull (COM 8.5e-4 vs 3e-5 bar) and lf-slant-hole2 (bbox 1.25 off): the bespoke OCCT builder is not an oracle for slanted round pulls. Row 63 discloses this and closed forms agree, so support rests on a single (closed-form) oracle for those cases.

wiring of the contract guard into the pane (row 87 unsupported; shipped route builds 187 wrong or should-be-refused cases)
mesh/display fidelity of slender curved parts
